scope: No Saving on question entry or text editing; sent-page wording and waiting-to-Chat regression
user_decisions: Answer This Question → Your answer must not show Saving
Write something real has no autosave, debounce or idle Loading
Introduction sent remains the result title; Done remains the bottom return button, explicitly confirmed by user
Deck/profile outgoing pending CTA is grey/inert Waiting for reply; after actual recipient acceptance it is Chat and opens the canonical conversation

data_contract.introduction_forms: UI-only Pinia state outside persisted data. draft_id, owner_user_id, auth_context, target_id, updated_at and form payload (question_id/mode/text/operation_id). No media body, relationship or balance lives here.
data_contract.stage_introduction_form: Pure UI choice; validate account, target and question, stage one form for this target and session. No transact, revision increment, storage or Loading.
data_contract.edit_introduction_form: Pure UI input/mode edit; no timer and no persistence. Back/mode switch keep this session's form. Unrelated business transactions cannot serialize it.
data_contract.persist_introduction_form: Explicit confirm/Get Coins/voice Review only, after custom write Loading. Publish owned form metadata through the normal atomic transaction adapter; spending remains the existing request+ledger transaction.
data_contract.introduction_context: Same read model with a transient form projection for editing. Persistent request/connection primary remains canonical and overrides completed forms. Fees and purchase recovery read published drafts only.
data_contract.refresh_and_account_scope: Refresh discards unpublished text. A validated question_id route can reconstruct an empty editor. Explicitly published drafts/media recover normally. Successful auth-context changes clear UI-only forms; failed writes preserve them.
data_contract.migration: No schema or seed migration, no automatic draft writes, and no retroactive debit. Previously saved drafts remain readable.

interactions.preconditions: Authenticated eligible account, visible target, target-owned selected question and no pending request
interactions.visible_feedback: Immediate normal page transition; no Saving overlay or persistence delay
interactions.success_result: Stage UI-only form and open text/voice editor with stable user/form/question IDs
interactions.failure_result: Inline error; no request, coin or disk mutation
interactions.acceptance: Compare exact storage bytes and observe absence of visible Loading during entry, idle typing, Back and mode switch in Chrome and WKWebView

interactions.preconditions: Valid current form; editor not submitting or covered by confirmation
interactions.success_result: Keep <=300-character text in the UI form; no idle autosave timer
interactions.failure_result: Invalid/expired form cannot publish; no disk/fee mutation
interactions.persistence: none until explicit fee confirmation or Get Coins
interactions.sync_scope: Back/mode switch keep temporary text; refresh discards unpublished input
interactions.acceptance: Type, wait beyond the old 800ms+500ms autosave window, compare storage bytes and Loading observation; refresh and verify empty unpublished input

interactions.preconditions: Valid nonblank text and current eligible target
interactions.visible_feedback: Show fee confirmation/insufficiency immediately; no Saving merely to open the sheet
interactions.success_result: Explicit fee confirm publishes form then prepares shared spending under 500ms Loading; Get Coins publishes recovery context under Loading
interactions.failure_result: Cancel is read-only; storage failure preserves temporary answer and all request/balance state
interactions.persistence: Only at explicit confirmation/Get Coins; existing fee/atomicity contract unchanged
interactions.sync_scope: Published draft, Coin Center return, request/ledger and pending primary
interactions.acceptance: Main composer and payment-regression browser/native reports

interactions.visible_feedback: Header Introduction sent; bottom Done; normal return transition
interactions.success_result: Return to Discover with grey Waiting for reply, not another introduction flow
interactions.failure_result: No accidental acceptance, extra spend or duplicate request
interactions.sync_scope: Same request and relationship-derived deck/profile primary
interactions.acceptance: Exact header/footer text plus pending deck/profile mouse/keyboard disable and refresh checks

acceptance_scope: Focused change; no whole-App or previously deferred page acceptance promoted to verified. Main browser test explicitly accepts as recipient; native accepted-state entry test uses that generated accepted snapshot.
